comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body:
@dgsudharsan , no, this particular fix needs to be in the master branch, because this is a change in the sonic-mgmt docker itself,  and updates to that docker are currently coming from master branch.

Pulling the latest sonic-mgmt docker should bring in the fix.

linkedPullRequests.title: Upgrade paramiko in docker-sonic-mgmt to 2.9.5
linkedPullRequests.author: saiarcot895
linkedPullRequests.body:

     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it

With Debian Bookworm, Paramiko 2.9 or newer will need to be used to be able to connect to devices running that version of Debian (specifically, to those running OpenSSH 9.2).

Fixes #16851.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Paramiko is currently on 3.3.1. For now, upgrade paramiko in docker-sonic-mgmt to 2.9.5.

#### How to verify it

Tested by running `tacacs/test_accounting.py` on a KVM image with Bookworm base image, and verifying that it all passed.

Note that there is a small risk of breakage of other tests due to the Paramiko update.
